players.blurb: Leader and star fragger of Aimpunch, he built a dynasty of multiple S-Tier titles and a Major, powered by an 18-match unbeaten run in S-Tier play.
A journeyman American in-game leader who vowed to build a better team than the one he left, then made good on it with PepegaX and their Audax Esse 2025 miracle run.
